solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes** the daily activities of chimpanzees, including their feeding times.**
 
• The appropriate noun should** indicate a specific duration of time during the 1day when feeding occurs.**
 
• "**Period**" fits well as it denotes a distinct length of time within a day, which aligns with the context of the passage.
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 2 is** 'period.'**

Hence, the correct sentence should read **"****After a lengthy midday rest, late afternoon is usually the most intensive feeding period__."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options ("era", "movement", "group") do not fit the context of describing a specific time duration for feeding within a day.

 
• **Era** (युग): "Era" implies a long and distinct period of history, which is too extensive for the context of daily feeding activities.
 
• **Movement **(आंदोलन): "Movement" can mean physical motion or a social campaign, but it does not denote a specific time period suitable for the context.
 
• **Group** (समूह): "Group" refers to a collection of individuals or things, which does not fit the context of describing a specific time period.
